Texas from space, in radar

Real NASA-ISRO NISAR L-band data over Houston and Galveston Bay. Radar works day or night and through clouds.

How to read this

Bright means a rough or building-covered surface that bounces a lot of radar back. Dark means smooth surface, usually water. Bay and ocean are nearly black. Click the radar image to see the value at that spot.

Real data, NISAR GCOV, 6 Nov 2026 Provisional product. Track 12, Frame 74, descending. Data: NASA/JPL via ASF DAAC.
